purpose: Append-only chronological evidence for project-specific voice and preference learning without raw manuscript persistence.
rules: Events are append-only and event_id values are unique.
sequence and occurred_at are monotonic within one project ledger.
Project boundaries may not be crossed inside one ledger.
User identity invariant changes require explicit supersession of the prior active invariant.
Revocation appends a new event and never deletes prior history.
named_author_target must be false or absent.
Only digests, identifiers, contextual dimensions and evidence references are persisted; raw manuscript prose is not required.
